Claude Nov 03, 18:06 UTC
I've read both PDFs and looked at the four moodboards. The brief says to plan first and wait for approval, so here are the milestones and the open questions. The only real overlap with the assignment is scope: the assignment asks for "a game" and puts a working core game ahead of covering every feature. The brief's build order already handles that, because each game is finished before the next one starts, so there's always something you could submit. ## Milestones | # | Milestone | What gets built | Gate | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | **Skeleton** | • New git repo in this folder; reference files moved to `docs/reference/`<br>• Backend: Spring Boot 3.5 on Java 21 with a Maven wrapper; the shared `core/` interfaces (`GameEngine`, `AiPlayer`, `Outcome`, …); Flyway tables for `games` and `moves`; a `/api/games` stub; ProblemDetail errors; actuator<br>• Frontend: Vite + React + TypeScript; router, design tokens, shared components (TopBar, Modal, Drawer, ConfirmDialog, Toast, SegmentedControl)<br>• Dockerfiles, compose file, `.env.example`, Makefile and `CLAUDE.md` | Builds and tests pass; app runs locally | | 2 | **Connect Four** (sets the pattern for the other two) | • Bitboard engine<br>• AI at three levels: Easy (mostly random), Medium (depth-5 minimax), Hard (negamax with a transposition table and iterative deepening, 1 s budget)<br>• GameService that loads the game, checks the version, applies the move, runs the AI and saves, all in one transaction, and returns an events list<br>• Ocean scene, SVG board, drop animation, keyboard play, result modal, resume after refresh, settings | All §11 Connect Four tests, Vitest, Playwright e2e and layout tests pass; screenshots reviewed at 4 viewports | | 3 | **Checkers** | • Legal moves as complete jump paths<br>• A man crowned mid-jump stops there<br>• 40-move rule and threefold repetition<br>• Board flips for Light<br>• Winter scene | Same as Connect Four | | 4 | **Backgammon** | • Search over every way to play the dice (max-dice and larger-die rules, duplicates removed); bar, closeout, bear-off; single, gammon and backgammon scoring<br>• Rule tests pass before UI work starts<br>• Desert scene, turn built step by step with Undo and Confirm, dice tumble | Same as Connect Four | | 5 | **Home** | • Jungle scene<br>• Three cards using the scene thumbnails<br>• W/L/D record from `/api/stats`<br>• Continue button | Screenshots | | 6 | **Polish** | Motion, reduced motion, keyboard and contrast passes, then a full screenshot review | Screenshots | | 7 | **Kubernetes + docs** | Kustomize manifests, README with a Mermaid diagram, DECISIONS, TIME_LOG | — | | 8 | **Stretch** | Hint, takeback, sound, doubling cube, in that order, only if time is left | — | ## Open questions and decisions 1. **Docker isn't installed, and neither is WSL.** That means I can't run `docker compose up`, Testcontainers or kind on this machine. My plan: - I build and test everything that doesn't need Docker: engines, AI, API and frontend. - To run the full app for Playwright and screenshots, I'll download the official portable PostgreSQL 16 zip for Windows (about 300 MB, from enterprisedb.com) into a temp folder, outside the project. - I'll still write the compose and k8s files, but they stay untested until Docker is available. - If you install Docker Desktop at some point (it needs WSL2 and a reboot), I'll check those two gates then. - Approving this plan also okays that one download. 2. **Java:** the system JDK is 17, but the brief needs 21 or later. I'll build locally with the JetBrains JDK 25 already in `~/.jdks`, compiled for Java 21. The Docker image runs on Temurin 21. I'll log this in `docs/DECISIONS.md`. 3. **Git:** this folder is currently inside a repo rooted at your home folder (`C:\Users\ustec`). I'll start a new repo in `Chess_Project` so no commits land there. Commits stay local until you give me a remote. 4. **Missing reference PDFs:** `checkers-rules.pdf`, `backgammon_Official-Rules.pdf` and the Connect 4 playbook aren't in the folder. Section 5 of the brief overrides them anyway, so I'll work from it. If you have them, drop them into `docs/reference/`. 5. **Moodboards:** I'll move them to `docs/reference/moodboards/` and keep them out of git. They're Pinterest captures of other people's photos, and the brief says never to ship them. 6. **Smaller version choices:** Vite 6, because Vite 7 needs a newer Node than your 20.17. The Makefile is written for reviewers on macOS or Linux, since `make` isn't installed here.

  "content": "package com.threeclassics.core;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Optional;\nimport java.util.random.RandomGenerator;\n\n/**\n * The rules of one game. Implementations are pure: states are immutable and {@link #apply}\n * returns a new state. Every game starts with {@link Side#P1} to act.\n *\n * @param <S> immutable game state, serialised to JSON for storage and for the client\n * @param <M> a complete move (a whole multi-jump or a whole backgammon turn), also JSON\n */\npublic interface GameEngine<S, M> {\n\n    S initialState();\n\n    Side sideToMove(S state);\n\n    /** Every legal move for the side to move. Empty once the game is over. */\n    List<M> legalMoves(S state);\n\n    /**\n     * Applies a move after checking that it is legal.\n     *\n     * @param rng source of chance (dice); never use a global random inside an engine\n     * @throws IllegalMoveException if the move is not in {@link #legalMoves}\n     */\n    S apply(S state, M move, RandomGenerator rng);\n\n    /** Present once the game is over. */\n    Optional<Outcome> outcome(S state);\n\n    /** Short human-readable notation for the move list, e.g. \"c3×e5\" or \"24/18 13/9\". */\n    String notation(M move);\n\n    /**\n     * The move as it should be stored in history. Lets chance moves record what happened,\n     * e.g. a backgammon roll records its dice. Defaults to the move itself.\n     */\n    default M recorded(S before, M move, S after) {\n        return move;\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "package com.threeclassics.core;\n\n/**\n * How a game ended.\n *\n * @param winner null for a draw\n * @param reason short explanation shown under the result title, e.g. \"Four in a row (diagonal)\"\n * @param points 1 for most wins; backgammon gammons and backgammons score 2 and 3\n */\npublic record Outcome(Side winner, String reason, int points) {\n\n    public static Outcome win(Side winner, String reason) {\n        return new Outcome(winner, reason, 1);\n    }\n\n    public static Outcome win(Side winner, String reason, int points) {\n        return new Outcome(winner, reason, points);\n    }\n\n    public static Outcome draw(String reason) {\n        return new Outcome(null, reason, 0);\n    }\n\n    public boolean isDraw() {\n        return winner == null;\n    }\n}\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\backend\\src\\main\\java\\com\\threeclassics\\service\\RematchPolicy.java",
  "content": "package com.threeclassics.service;\n\nimport com.threeclassics.core.GameMode;\nimport com.threeclassics.core.GameType;\nimport com.threeclassics.core.Side;\n\n/** Decides which seat the human takes in a new game. */\nfinal class RematchPolicy {\n\n    private RematchPolicy() {\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * An explicit choice always wins. Otherwise a Connect Four rematch swaps who goes first, as the\n     * rules suggest for fairness; other games keep the human's previous seat.\n     */\n    static Side humanSide(NewGame request, Side previousHumanSide) {\n        if (request.mode() == GameMode.LOCAL) {\n            return Side.P1;\n        }\n        if (request.humanSide() != null) {\n            return request.humanSide();\n        }\n        if (previousHumanSide != null) {\n            return request.type() == GameType.CONNECT_FOUR ? previousHumanSide.opponent() : previousHumanSide;\n        }\n        return Side.P1;\n    }\n}\n"
}

Only exists\n * in the dev and test profiles; the default profile has no such route.\n */\n@RestController\n@Profile({\"dev\", \"test\"})\n@RequestMapping(\"/api/dev\")\nclass DevGameController {\n\n    private final GameService service;\n\n    DevGameController(GameService service) {\n        this.service = service;\n    }\n\n    @PostMapping(\"/games\")\n    @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED)\n    MoveResult create(@Valid @RequestBody DevGameRequest request) {\n        return service.createFromState(request.game().toNewGame(), request.state());\n    }\n\n    record DevGameRequest(@NotNull @Valid CreateGameRequest game, @NotNull JsonNode state) {\n    }\n}\n"

  "content": "package com.threeclassics.api;\n\nimport com.threeclassics.core.IllegalMoveException;\nimport com.threeclassics.service.GameNotFoundException;\nimport com.threeclassics.service.StaleVersionException;\nimport org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;\nimport org.springframework.http.ProblemDetail;\nimport org.springframework.orm.ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;\nimport org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;\nimport org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.ResponseEntityExceptionHandler;\n\n/** Maps domain errors to RFC 9457 problem details. Framework errors are handled by the base class. */\n@RestControllerAdvice\nclass ApiExceptionHandler extends ResponseEntityExceptionHandler {\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalMoveException.class)\n    ProblemDetail illegalMove(IllegalMoveException e) {\n        return problem(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, \"Illegal move\", e.getMessage());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)\n    ProblemDetail badRequest(IllegalArgumentException e) {\n        return problem(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, \"Bad request\", e.getMessage());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(GameNotFoundException.class)\n    ProblemDetail notFound(GameNotFoundException e) {\n        return problem(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, \"Game not found\", e.getMessage());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(StaleVersionException.class)\n    ProblemDetail stale(StaleVersionException e) {\n        return problem(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, \"Stale game version\", e.getMessage());\n    }\n\n    @ExceptionHandler(ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException.class)\n    ProblemDetail concurrentUpdate(ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException e) {\n        return problem(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, \"Stale game version\", \"The game changed while this move was being made.\");\n    }\n\n    private static ProblemDetail problem(HttpStatus status, String title, String detail) {\n        ProblemDetail problem = ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(status, detail);\n        problem.setTitle(title);\n        return problem;\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "// localStorage can throw (private mode, blocked storage), so every access is guarded and the app\n// keeps working without it.\n\nexport function readJson<T>(key: string, fallback: T): T {\n  try {\n    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);\n    return raw === null ? fallback : (JSON.parse(raw) as T);\n  } catch {\n    return fallback;\n  }\n}\n\nexport function writeJson(key: string, value: unknown): void {\n  try {\n    window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));\n  } catch {\n    // Storage unavailable: the value simply isn't remembered.\n  }\n}\n\nexport function removeKey(key: string): void {\n  try {\n    window.localStorage.removeItem(key);\n  } catch {\n    // Nothing to do.\n  }\n}\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\frontend\\src\\app\\settings.tsx",
  "content": "import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';\nimport { readJson, writeJson } from './storage';\n\ninterface Settings {\n  /** Ambient scene motion (falling snow, bubbles...). Pieces still move either way. */\n  ambientMotion: boolean;\n  setAmbientMotion: (on: boolean) => void;\n}\n\nconst SettingsContext = createContext<Settings | null>(null);\nconst STORAGE_KEY = 'tc.settings';\n\nfunction prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {\n  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;\n}\n\nexport function SettingsProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n  const [ambientMotion, setAmbientMotion] = useState<boolean>(() => {\n    const stored = readJson<{ ambientMotion?: boolean }>(STORAGE_KEY, {});\n    return stored.ambientMotion ?? !prefersReducedMotion();\n  });\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    writeJson(STORAGE_KEY, { ambientMotion });\n  }, [ambientMotion]);\n\n  const value = useMemo(() => ({ ambientMotion, setAmbientMotion }), [ambientMotion]);\n  return <SettingsContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</SettingsContext.Provider>;\n}\n\nexport function useSettings(): Settings {\n  const settings = useContext(SettingsContext);\n  if (!settings) throw new Error('useSettings must be used inside SettingsProvider');\n  return settings;\n}\n"
}

  "content": "// Mirrors the Spring Boot DTOs in backend/src/main/java/com/threeclassics/service.\n\nexport type GameType = 'CONNECT_FOUR' | 'CHECKERS' | 'BACKGAMMON';\nexport type GameMode = 'VS_AI' | 'LOCAL';\nexport type Difficulty = 'EASY' | 'MEDIUM' | 'HARD';\nexport type Side = 'P1' | 'P2';\nexport type Actor = 'HUMAN' | 'AI' | 'P1' | 'P2';\nexport type GameStatus = 'IN_PROGRESS' | 'FINISHED';\n\nexport interface Outcome {\n  winner: Side | null;\n  reason: string;\n  points: number;\n  draw: boolean;\n}\n\nexport interface HistoryEntry<M> {\n  ply: number;\n  side: Side;\n  actor: Actor;\n  move: M;\n  notation: string;\n}\n\nexport interface GameView<S, M> {\n  id: string;\n  type: GameType;\n  mode: GameMode;\n  difficulty: Difficulty;\n  humanSide: Side;\n  version: number;\n  status: GameStatus;\n  sideToMove: Side;\n  state: S;\n  legalMoves: M[];\n  outcome: Outcome | null;\n  lastMove: HistoryEntry<M> | null;\n  history: HistoryEntry<M>[];\n}\n\nexport interface GameEvent<S, M> {\n  ply: number;\n  side: Side;\n  actor: Actor;\n  move: M;\n  notation: string;\n  state: S;\n}\n\nexport interface MoveResult<S, M> {\n  game: GameView<S, M>;\n  events: GameEvent<S, M>[];\n}\n\nexport interface NewGameRequest {\n  type: GameType;\n  mode: GameMode;\n  difficulty: Difficulty;\n  humanSide?: Side;\n  rematchOf?: string;\n}\n\nexport interface StatsEntry {\n  type: GameType;\n  difficulty: Difficulty;\n  wins: number;\n  losses: number;\n  draws: number;\n}\n\nexport interface Problem {\n  title?: string;\n  detail?: string;\n  status?: number;\n}\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\frontend\\src\\api\\client.ts",
  "content": "import type { GameView, MoveResult, NewGameRequest, Problem, StatsEntry } from './types';\n\nexport class ApiError extends Error {\n  constructor(\n    readonly status: number,\n    readonly problem: Problem,\n  ) {\n    super(problem.detail ?? problem.title ?? `Request failed with ${status}`);\n  }\n\n  get isStale(): boolean {\n    return this.status === 409;\n  }\n\n  get isNotFound(): boolean {\n    return this.status === 404;\n  }\n}\n\nasync function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {\n  const response = await fetch(path, {\n    ...init,\n    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json', ...init?.headers },\n  });\n  if (!response.ok) {\n    let problem: Problem = {};\n    try {\n      problem = (await response.json()) as Problem;\n    } catch {\n      // Not a problem-detail body; keep the status only.\n    }\n    throw new ApiError(response.status, problem);\n  }\n  return (await response.json()) as T;\n}\n\nexport const api = {\n  createGame<S, M>(body: NewGameRequest): Promise<MoveResult<S, M>> {\n    return request('/api/games', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body) });\n  },\n\n  getGame<S, M>(id: string): Promise<GameView<S, M>> {\n    return request(`/api/games/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);\n  },\n\n  move<S, M>(id: string, version: number, move: M): Promise<MoveResult<S, M>> {\n    return request(`/api/games/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/moves`, {\n      method: 'POST',\n      body: JSON.stringify({ version, move }),\n    });\n  },\n\n  stats(): Promise<StatsEntry[]> {\n    return request('/api/stats');\n  },\n};\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\frontend\\src\\components\\useFocusTrap.ts",
  "content": "import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';\n\nconst FOCUSABLE =\n  'button:not([disabled]), [href], input:not([disabled]), select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex=\"-1\"])';\n\n/**\n * While active: moves focus into the container, keeps Tab inside it, calls onEscape on Esc, and\n * on deactivation returns focus to whatever had it before (or to returnFocus if given).\n */\nexport function useFocusTrap(\n  container: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,\n  active: boolean,\n  onEscape?: () => void,\n  returnFocus?: RefObject<HTMLElement | SVGElement | null>,\n) {\n  const escape = useRef(onEscape);\n  escape.current = onEscape;\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const node = container.current;\n    if (!active || !node) return;\n    const previous = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;\n    const focusables = () => Array.from(node.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE));\n    (node.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-autofocus]') ?? focusables()[0] ?? node).focus();\n\n    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {\n      if (event.key === 'Escape') {\n        event.stopPropagation();\n        escape.current?.();\n        return;\n      }\n      if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;\n      const items = focusables();\n      if (items.length === 0) {\n        event.preventDefault();\n        return;\n      }\n      const first = items[0];\n      const last = items[items.length - 1];\n      if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {\n        event.preventDefault();\n        last.focus();\n      } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {\n        event.preventDefault();\n        first.focus();\n      }\n    }\n\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, true);\n    return () => {\n      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, true);\n      const target = returnFocus?.current ?? previous;\n      if (target && 'focus' in target) target.focus({ preventScroll: true });\n    };\n  }, [active, container, returnFocus]);\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { forwardRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from 'react';\nimport styles from './Button.module.css';\n\ntype Variant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost';\n\ninterface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {\n  variant?: Variant;\n  icon?: ReactNode;\n}\n\nexport const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(function Button(\n  { variant = 'secondary', icon, children, className, type = 'button', ...rest },\n  ref,\n) {\n  return (\n    <button ref={ref} type={type} className={[styles.button, styles[variant], className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')} {...rest}>\n      {icon}\n      {children && <span>{children}</span>}\n    </button>\n  );\n});\n\ninterface IconButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {\n  label: string;\n  icon: ReactNode;\n}\n\n/** A square icon-only button. The label is its accessible name and tooltip. */\nexport const IconButton = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, IconButtonProps>(function IconButton(\n  { label, icon, className, type = 'button', ...rest },\n  ref,\n) {\n  return (\n    <button\n      ref={ref}\n      type={type}\n      aria-label={label}\n      title={label}\n      className={[styles.button, styles.ghost, styles.icon, className].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}\n      {...rest}\n    >\n      {icon}\n    </button>\n  );\n});\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\frontend\\src\\components\\SegmentedControl.tsx",
  "content": "import { useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';\nimport styles from './SegmentedControl.module.css';\n\nexport interface Segment<T extends string> {\n  value: T;\n  label: string;\n}\n\ninterface SegmentedControlProps<T extends string> {\n  label: string;\n  options: Segment<T>[];\n  value: T;\n  onChange: (value: T) => void;\n  size?: 'sm' | 'md';\n  disabled?: boolean;\n}\n\n/** A radio group drawn as joined buttons. Arrow keys move the selection. */\nexport function SegmentedControl<T extends string>({\n  label,\n  options,\n  value,\n  onChange,\n  size = 'md',\n  disabled = false,\n}: SegmentedControlProps<T>) {\n  const refs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);\n\n  function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent, index: number) {\n    const step = event.key === 'ArrowRight' || event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : 0;\n    if (step === 0) return;\n    event.preventDefault();\n    const next = (index + step + options.length) % options.length;\n    refs.current[next]?.focus();\n    onChange(options[next].value);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div role=\"radiogroup\" aria-label={label} className={[styles.group, styles[size]].join(' ')}>\n      {options.map((option, index) => {\n        const checked = option.value === value;\n        return (\n          <button\n            key={option.value}\n            ref={(el) => {\n              refs.current[index] = el;\n            }}\n            type=\"button\"\n            role=\"radio\"\n            aria-checked={checked}\n            tabIndex={checked ? 0 : -1}\n            disabled={disabled}\n            className={styles.segment}\n            onClick={() => onChange(option.value)}\n            onKeyDown={(event) => onKeyDown(event, index)}\n          >\n            {option.label}\n          </button>\n        );\n      })}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

{

  "content": "import { useRef, type ReactNode, type RefObject } from 'react';\nimport { createPortal } from 'react-dom';\nimport { useFocusTrap } from './useFocusTrap';\nimport styles from './Modal.module.css';\n\ninterface ModalProps {\n  open: boolean;\n  onClose: () => void;\n  labelledBy: string;\n  describedBy?: string;\n  children: ReactNode;\n  /** Where focus goes when the modal closes, e.g. the board. Defaults to the previous focus. */\n  returnFocus?: RefObject<HTMLElement | SVGElement | null>;\n  /** Optional themed flourish rendered behind the dialog (bubbles, snow, sand). */\n  flourish?: ReactNode;\n}\n\nexport function Modal({ open, onClose, labelledBy, describedBy, children, returnFocus, flourish }: ModalProps) {\n  const dialog = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n  useFocusTrap(dialog, open, onClose, returnFocus);\n  if (!open) return null;\n\n  return createPortal(\n    <div className={styles.root}>\n      <div className={styles.backdrop} onClick={onClose} />\n      {flourish}\n      <div\n        ref={dialog}\n        role=\"dialog\"\n        aria-modal=\"true\"\n        aria-labelledby={labelledBy}\n        aria-describedby={describedBy}\n        tabIndex={-1}\n        className={styles.dialog}\n      >\n        {children}\n      </div>\n    </div>,\n    document.body,\n  );\n}\n"
}

}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\frontend\\src\\components\\Drawer.tsx",
  "content": "import { useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';\nimport { createPortal } from 'react-dom';\nimport { X } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { IconButton } from './Button';\nimport { useFocusTrap } from './useFocusTrap';\nimport styles from './Drawer.module.css';\n\ninterface DrawerProps {\n  open: boolean;\n  title: string;\n  onClose: () => void;\n  children: ReactNode;\n}\n\n/** A panel that slides in from the right, used for the rules. */\nexport function Drawer({ open, title, onClose, children }: DrawerProps) {\n  const panel = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);\n  const titleId = useId();\n  useFocusTrap(panel, open, onClose);\n  if (!open) return null;\n\n  return createPortal(\n    <div className={styles.root}>\n      <div className={styles.backdrop} onClick={onClose} />\n      <aside ref={panel} role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\" aria-labelledby={titleId} className={styles.panel}>\n        <header className={styles.header}>\n          <h2 id={titleId} className={styles.title}>\n            {title}\n          </h2>\n          <IconButton label=\"Close\" icon={<X strokeWidth={1.75} />} onClick={onClose} data-autofocus />\n        </header>\n        <div className={styles.body}>{children}</div>\n      </aside>\n    </div>,\n    document.body,\n  );\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { useId } from 'react';\nimport { Button } from './Button';\nimport { Modal } from './Modal';\nimport styles from './ConfirmDialog.module.css';\n\ninterface ConfirmDialogProps {\n  open: boolean;\n  title: string;\n  message?: string;\n  confirmLabel: string;\n  onConfirm: () => void;\n  onCancel: () => void;\n}\n\nexport function ConfirmDialog({ open, title, message, confirmLabel, onConfirm, onCancel }: ConfirmDialogProps) {\n  const titleId = useId();\n  const messageId = useId();\n  return (\n    <Modal open={open} onClose={onCancel} labelledBy={titleId} describedBy={message ? messageId : undefined}>\n      <h2 id={titleId} className={styles.title}>\n        {title}\n      </h2>\n      {message && (\n        <p id={messageId} className={styles.message}>\n          {message}\n        </p>\n      )}\n      <div className={styles.actions}>\n        <Button variant=\"secondary\" onClick={onCancel}>\n          Cancel\n        </Button>\n        <Button variant=\"primary\" onClick={onConfirm} data-autofocus>\n          {confirmLabel}\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n    </Modal>\n  );\n}\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\frontend\\src\\components\\Toast.tsx",
  "content": "import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';\nimport styles from './Toast.module.css';\n\ninterface ToastApi {\n  show: (message: string) => void;\n}\n\nconst ToastContext = createContext<ToastApi | null>(null);\nconst DURATION_MS = 2600;\n\n/** One short message at a time, announced politely to screen readers. */\nexport function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {\n  const [toast, setToast] = useState<{ id: number; message: string } | null>(null);\n  const timer = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);\n\n  const show = useCallback((message: string) => {\n    window.clearTimeout(timer.current);\n    setToast({ id: Date.now(), message });\n    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setToast(null), DURATION_MS);\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), []);\n  const api = useMemo(() => ({ show }), [show]);\n\n  return (\n    <ToastContext.Provider value={api}>\n      {children}\n      <div className={styles.region} role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\">\n        {toast && (\n          <div key={toast.id} className={styles.toast}>\n            {toast.message}\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </ToastContext.Provider>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function useToast(): ToastApi {\n  const api = useContext(ToastContext);\n  if (!api) throw new Error('useToast must be used inside ToastProvider');\n  return api;\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport { Settings } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useSettings } from '../app/settings';\nimport { IconButton } from './Button';\nimport styles from './SettingsMenu.module.css';\n\nexport function SettingsMenu() {\n  const { ambientMotion, setAmbientMotion } = useSettings();\n  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);\n  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n  const button = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);\n  const menuId = useId();\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!open) return;\n    function onPointerDown(event: PointerEvent) {\n      if (!root.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false);\n    }\n    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {\n      if (event.key === 'Escape') {\n        setOpen(false);\n        button.current?.focus();\n      }\n    }\n    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown);\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);\n    return () => {\n      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown);\n      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);\n    };\n  }, [open]);\n\n  return (\n    <div ref={root} className={styles.root}>\n      <IconButton\n        ref={button}\n        label=\"Settings\"\n        icon={<Settings strokeWidth={1.75} />}\n        aria-expanded={open}\n        aria-controls={menuId}\n        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}\n      />\n      {open && (\n        <div id={menuId} className={styles.menu}>\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            role=\"switch\"\n            aria-checked={ambientMotion}\n            className={styles.row}\n            onClick={() => setAmbientMotion(!ambientMotion)}\n          >\n            <span>Ambient motion</span>\n            <span className={styles.switch} aria-hidden=\"true\">\n              <span className={styles.thumb} />\n            </span>\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\frontend\\src\\themes\\scene\\ticker.ts",
  "content": "// One requestAnimationFrame loop per page, shared by every scene on it. It stops when nothing is\n// subscribed and pauses while the tab is hidden.\n\nexport type Tick = (dt: number, now: number) => void;\n\nconst subscribers = new Set<Tick>();\nlet frame = 0;\nlet last = 0;\n\nfunction loop(now: number) {\n  // Clamp so a long frame (e.g. after a hitch) never teleports particles.\n  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);\n  last = now;\n  subscribers.forEach((tick) => tick(dt, now));\n  frame = requestAnimationFrame(loop);\n}\n\nfunction start() {\n  if (frame || subscribers.size === 0 || document.hidden) return;\n  last = performance.now();\n  frame = requestAnimationFrame(loop);\n}\n\nfunction stop() {\n  cancelAnimationFrame(frame);\n  frame = 0;\n}\n\nif (typeof document !== 'undefined') {\n  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => (document.hidden ? stop() : start()));\n}\n\nexport function subscribe(tick: Tick): () => void {\n  subscribers.add(tick);\n  start();\n  return () => {\n    subscribers.delete(tick);\n    if (subscribers.size === 0) stop();\n  };\n}\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\frontend\\src\\themes\\scene\\ParticleCanvas.tsx",
  "content": "import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\nimport { subscribe } from './ticker';\n\n/** A particle system drawn in CSS pixels. Created per canvas size; stepped by the shared ticker. */\nexport interface ParticleField {\n  update(dt: number, now: number): void;\n  draw(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D): void;\n}\n\n/**\n * @param scale particle-count multiplier: 1 at 1440×900, less on small screens\n */\nexport type ParticleFactory = (width: number, height: number, scale: number) => ParticleField;\n\ninterface ParticleCanvasProps {\n  create: ParticleFactory;\n  animate: boolean;\n  className?: string;\n}\n\nconst REFERENCE_AREA = 1440 * 900;\n\nexport function ParticleCanvas({ create, animate, className }: ParticleCanvasProps) {\n  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const canvas = canvasRef.current;\n    const ctx = canvas?.getContext('2d');\n    if (!canvas || !ctx) return;\n\n    let field: ParticleField | null = null;\n    let width = 0;\n    let height = 0;\n\n    function render() {\n      if (!ctx || !field) return;\n      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);\n      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);\n      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);\n      field.draw(ctx);\n    }\n\n    function resize() {\n      if (!canvas) return;\n      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();\n      if (rect.width === 0 || rect.height === 0) return;\n      width = rect.width;\n      height = rect.height;\n      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);\n      canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);\n      canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);\n      const scale = Math.min(1.2, Math.max(0.3, (width * height) / REFERENCE_AREA));\n      field = create(width, height, scale);\n      render();\n    }\n\n    resize();\n    const observer = new ResizeObserver(resize);\n    observer.observe(canvas);\n\n    const unsubscribe = animate\n      ? subscribe((dt, now) => {\n          field?.update(dt, now);\n          render();\n        })\n      : undefined;\n\n    return () => {\n      observer.disconnect();\n      unsubscribe?.();\n    };\n  }, [create, animate]);\n\n  return <canvas ref={canvasRef} className={className} aria-hidden=\"true\" />;\n}\n"
}

{

  "content": "import type { ReactNode } from 'react';\nimport { ParticleCanvas, type ParticleFactory } from './ParticleCanvas';\nimport styles from './SceneFrame.module.css';\n\nexport type SceneMode = 'full' | 'thumbnail';\n\nexport interface SceneProps {\n  /** Full-page backdrop, or a static card thumbnail that only moves while hovered. */\n  mode?: SceneMode;\n  animate: boolean;\n  /** Darken and desaturate behind the board so the scene stays a backdrop. */\n  scrim?: boolean;\n}\n\ninterface SceneFrameProps extends SceneProps {\n  name: string;\n  particles?: ParticleFactory;\n  children: ReactNode;\n}\n\n/**\n * Layers, back to front: an optional photo (set --scene-photo to a licensed image), the SVG\n * silhouettes, one particle canvas, then the scrim.\n */\nexport function SceneFrame({ name, mode = 'full', animate, scrim = false, particles, children }: SceneFrameProps) {\n  return (\n    <div className={styles.scene} data-scene={name} data-mode={mode} data-animate={animate} aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <div className={styles.photo} />\n      {children}\n      {particles && <ParticleCanvas create={particles} animate={animate} className={styles.canvas} />}\n      {scrim && <div className={styles.scrim} />}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

Paused keyframes still show a natural frame. */\n.scene:not([data-animate='true']) :global(*) {\n  animation-play-state: paused !important;\n}\n\n/* Darkens and desaturates the backdrop by roughly half, strongest behind the board. */\n.scrim {\n  position: absolute;\n  inset: 0;\n  background:\n    radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 75% at 45% 55%, var(--ui-scrim) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-scrim) 55%, transparent) 70%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-scrim) 35%, transparent) 100%);\n  backdrop-filter: saturate(0.55);\n}\n"

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\CLAUDE.md",
  "content": "# Three Classics\n\nConnect Four, Checkers and Backgammon against the computer. The brief is `docs/reference/game-build-prompt.pdf`; its Section 5 rules win over the rulebooks.\n\n## Stack\n- Backend: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.5, JPA, Flyway, PostgreSQL 16, Maven wrapper (`backend/`)\n- Frontend: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 6, plain CSS Modules + CSS variables, lucide-react (`frontend/`)\n- Infra: Docker Compose (`docker-compose.yml`), Kustomize (`k8s/`), `Makefile`\n\n## Commands\n- Run everything: `docker compose up --build` → http://localhost:8080\n- Backend tests: `cd backend && ./mvnw test` (set `TEST_DATABASE_URL` to skip Testcontainers)\n- Frontend: `npm run dev` (proxies /api to :8080), `npm test` (Vitest), `npm run e2e` (Playwright)\n- Backend with dev endpoint: `./mvnw spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=dev`\n\n## Layout\n- `backend/.../core` shared `GameEngine<S,M>`, `AiPlayer<S,M>`, `Outcome`, `Side`; one package per game\n- `backend/.../service/GameService` is the referee: load → check version → apply → AI reply → persist\n- `frontend/src/games/<game>` board + page; `games/shared` session hook, page shell, prefix matcher\n- `frontend/src/themes/<theme>` palette + Scene; `themes/scene` shared ticker/particles\n\n## Rules of the codebase\n- The server is the referee. The client only renders state and picks from `legalMoves`.\n- Engines are pure: immutable state, `apply` returns new state, randomness only via injected `RandomGenerator`.\n\n## Board layout (non-negotiable)\n- One `<svg>` per board with a fixed viewBox; pieces are a fixed fraction of a cell.\n- Board box has a fixed aspect-ratio, is the largest fit (cap ~760px tall), centred in its column.\n- Nothing reflows during play: highlights use SVG fills/rings/transforms/opacity only; status, dice and\n  \"thinking…\" lines reserve their height. Top bar 56px; side panel 280px at ≥1100px, else below the board.\n- Radial scrim behind the board; board on a solid surface with one soft shadow; WCAG AA text.\n- No scrollbars at 1280×720; playable at 390×844.\n\n## Anti-slop\nNo purple/indigo gradients, gradient text, neon glows, glassmorphism, emoji or sparkle icons, confetti,\nheavy shadows on rounded-everything, bouncing chrome, hero sections, fake stats/lorem, \"Powered by AI\",\nextra font families (Fraunces display + IBM Plex Sans UI only), or more than two accents per theme.\nDo: 8px spacing scale, short plain copy, Lucide icons at one stroke (1.75), visible focus rings,\ncolour plus shape for state, 8–12px radii. No Chess.com or Hasbro branding.\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\docs\\DECISIONS.md",
  "content": "# Decisions\n\nA running log of decisions made while building, newest at the bottom of each section. The\nsummary and \"what I'd do next\" sections are finalised at the end of the project.\n\n## Environment and tooling\n\n- **Spring Boot 3.5 rather than 4.x.** 3.5 is the mature line with the APIs I know best (Jackson 2,\n  Flyway starter auto-config). For a four-hour build, low risk beats the newest major version.\n- **Java 21 target, built with a newer JDK locally.** The dev machine only has JDK 17 system-wide, so\n  local builds use JetBrains Runtime 25 with `--release 21`. Containers build and run on Temurin 21.\n- **Vite 6.** Vite 7+ needs Node 20.19; the dev machine has 20.17. Vitest 3 matches Vite 6.\n- **No Docker on the dev machine.** Compose, Testcontainers and kind could not be run while building.\n  Engines, AI, service and frontend were tested against a portable local PostgreSQL 16 instead. The\n  integration tests use Testcontainers when Docker is present, or `TEST_DATABASE_URL` when it is not.\n- **No `@types/node` or jsdom.** Neither is on the approved list. The Vitest suites test pure\n  functions, so they need no DOM, and the config files are left out of `tsc`.\n- **Moodboards are git-ignored.** They are Pinterest captures of other people's photos; the brief says\n  never to ship them, so they stay local in `docs/reference/moodboards/`.\n\n## Architecture\n\n- **The server is the referee.** All rules and AI live in Java. The client renders `state`, offers only\n  `legalMoves`, and sends back the move it picked. One source of truth, unit-testable rules, and the\n  same shape a real game site uses to stop cheating.\n- **One `GameEngine<S, M>` interface for three games.** Each game is a `GameModule` (engine, AI, JSON\n  types). `GameService` is written once against the interface; adding a game means adding a module bean.\n- **Create returns the same envelope as a move** (`{ game, events }` rather than a bare `GameView`). When\n  the computer moves first, its opening move arrives as an event and animates like any other reply.\n- **Rematches go through the server.** `POST /api/games` takes an optional `rematchOf`; the rule that a\n  Connect Four rematch swaps who goes first lives in `RematchPolicy` and is unit-tested.\n- **Optimistic locking twice over.** Each move names the version it was based on (409 on mismatch, which\n  stops double clicks), and JPA `@Version` guards concurrent writes as a backstop.\n- **Events carry a state snapshot.** Each event in a response includes the state right after it, so the\n  client animates event by event and snaps to server truth after each one.\n"
}

  "content": "package com.threeclassics.connectfour;\n\nimport com.threeclassics.core.Side;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * A Connect Four position.\n *\n * @param columns      seven columns, each listing its discs from the bottom up\n * @param sideToMove   whose turn it is (P1, coral, always starts)\n * @param winningLines every line of four or more completed by the winning drop; empty otherwise\n * @param lastDrop     where the most recent disc landed, or null at the start\n */\npublic record ConnectFourState(\n        List<List<Side>> columns,\n        Side sideToMove,\n        List<WinLine> winningLines,\n        Cell lastDrop) {\n\n    public static final int COLUMNS = 7;\n    public static final int ROWS = 6;\n\n    public ConnectFourState {\n        if (columns.size() != COLUMNS) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Connect Four has \" + COLUMNS + \" columns\");\n        }\n        for (List<Side> column : columns) {\n            if (column.size() > ROWS) {\n                throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"A column holds at most \" + ROWS + \" discs\");\n            }\n        }\n        columns = columns.stream().map(List::copyOf).toList();\n        winningLines = winningLines == null ? List.of() : List.copyOf(winningLines);\n    }\n\n    /** The disc at a cell, or null if the cell is empty. Row 0 is the bottom. */\n    public Side at(int column, int row) {\n        List<Side> discs = columns.get(column);\n        return row < discs.size() ? discs.get(row) : null;\n    }\n\n    public int height(int column) {\n        return columns.get(column).size();\n    }\n\n    public boolean isFull() {\n        return columns.stream().allMatch(column -> column.size() == ROWS);\n    }\n\n    public record Cell(int column, int row) {\n    }\n\n    public enum Direction {\n        HORIZONTAL,\n        VERTICAL,\n        DIAGONAL_UP,\n        DIAGONAL_DOWN\n    }\n\n    public record WinLine(Direction direction, List<Cell> cells) {\n\n        public WinLine {\n            cells = List.copyOf(cells);\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "package com.threeclassics.connectfour;\n\nimport static com.threeclassics.connectfour.ConnectFourState.COLUMNS;\nimport static com.threeclassics.connectfour.ConnectFourState.ROWS;\n\nimport com.threeclassics.core.Side;\n\n/**\n * A mutable bitboard used only inside the AI search. Bit {@code column * 7 + row} is a cell; the\n * spare seventh bit per column keeps lines from wrapping between columns.\n *\n * <p>{@code current} holds the side to move's discs and {@code mask} all discs, so\n * {@code current + mask} identifies a position uniquely and serves as the transposition key.\n */\nfinal class Bitboard {\n\n    static final int STRIDE = ROWS + 1;\n    static final int CELLS = COLUMNS * ROWS;\n\n    long current;\n    long mask;\n    int moves;\n\n    private Bitboard() {\n    }\n\n    static Bitboard of(ConnectFourState state) {\n        Bitboard board = new Bitboard();\n        Side toMove = state.sideToMove();\n        for (int column = 0; column < COLUMNS; column++) {\n            for (int row = 0; row < state.height(column); row++) {\n                long bit = 1L << (column * STRIDE + row);\n                board.mask |= bit;\n                if (state.at(column, row) == toMove) {\n                    board.current |= bit;\n                }\n                board.moves++;\n            }\n        }\n        return board;\n    }\n\n    Bitboard copy() {\n        Bitboard copy = new Bitboard();\n        copy.current = current;\n        copy.mask = mask;\n        copy.moves = moves;\n        return copy;\n    }\n\n    boolean canPlay(int column) {\n        return (mask & topCell(column)) == 0;\n    }\n\n    void play(int column) {\n        current ^= mask;\n        mask |= mask + bottomCell(column);\n        moves++;\n    }\n\n    void undo(int column, long previousCurrent, long previousMask) {\n        current = previousCurrent;\n        mask = previousMask;\n        moves--;\n    }\n\n    /** True if the side to move would complete four in a row by playing this column. */\n    boolean isWinningMove(int column) {\n        long position = current | ((mask + bottomCell(column)) & columnMask(column));\n        return hasFour(position);\n    }\n\n    long key() {\n        return current + mask;\n    }\n\n    /** Discs of the side that just moved. */\n    long opponent() {\n        return current ^ mask;\n    }\n\n    static boolean hasFour(long position) {\n        long m = position & (position >> STRIDE);\n        if ((m & (m >> 2 * STRIDE)) != 0) return true; // horizontal\n        m = position & (position >> (STRIDE - 1));\n        if ((m & (m >> 2 * (STRIDE - 1))) != 0) return true; // diagonal down\n        m = position & (position >> (STRIDE + 1));\n        if ((m & (m >> 2 * (STRIDE + 1))) != 0) return true; // diagonal up\n        m = position & (position >> 1);\n        return (m & (m >> 2)) != 0; // vertical\n    }\n\n    static long bottomCell(int column) {\n        return 1L << (column * STRIDE);\n    }\n\n    static long topCell(int column) {\n        return 1L << (column * STRIDE + ROWS - 1);\n    }\n\n    static long columnMask(int column) {\n        return ((1L << ROWS) - 1) << (column * STRIDE);\n    }\n\n    static long cell(int column, int row) {\n        return 1L << (column * STRIDE + row);\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "package com.threeclassics.connectfour;\n\nimport com.threeclassics.core.Side;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/** Builds positions from pictures: top row first, X = P1 (coral), O = P2 (gold), . = empty. */\nfinal class Boards {\n\n    private Boards() {\n    }\n\n    static ConnectFourState parse(String picture, Side toMove) {\n        String[] lines = picture.strip().lines().map(String::strip).toArray(String[]::new);\n        if (lines.length != ConnectFourState.ROWS) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Expected 6 rows, got \" + lines.length);\n        }\n        List<List<Side>> columns = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int column = 0; column < ConnectFourState.COLUMNS; column++) {\n            List<Side> discs = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int row = 0; row < ConnectFourState.ROWS; row++) {\n                char c = lines[ConnectFourState.ROWS - 1 - row].charAt(column);\n                if (c == '.') {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                if (discs.size() != row) {\n                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"Floating disc in column \" + column);\n                }\n                discs.add(c == 'X' ? Side.P1 : Side.P2);\n            }\n            columns.add(discs);\n        }\n        return new ConnectFourState(columns, toMove, List.of(), null);\n    }\n}\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "C:\\Users\\ustec\\Downloads\\Chess_Project\\backend\\src\\test\\java\\com\\threeclassics\\core\\SoakTest.java",
  "content": "package com.threeclassics.core;\n\nimport static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;\n\nimport com.threeclassics.connectfour.ConnectFourAi;\nimport com.threeclassics.connectfour.ConnectFourEngine;\nimport java.time.Duration;\nimport java.util.Random;\nimport java.util.function.Consumer;\nimport org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;\n\n/** Plays many seeded Easy-vs-Easy games per game type and checks invariants after every move. */\nclass SoakTest {\n\n    private static final int GAMES = 500;\n    private static final int MAX_PLIES = 2_000;\n\n    @Test\n    void connectFourGamesRunToCompletion() {\n        soak(new ConnectFourEngine(), new ConnectFourAi(), state -> {\n        });\n    }\n\n    static <S, M> void soak(GameEngine<S, M> engine, AiPlayer<S, M> ai, Consumer<S> invariant) {\n        Random rng = new Random(42);\n        for (int game = 0; game < GAMES; game++) {\n            S state = engine.initialState();\n            int plies = 0;\n            while (engine.outcome(state).isEmpty()) {\n                M move = ai.chooseMove(state, Difficulty.EASY, rng, Duration.ofMillis(200));\n                assertThat(engine.legalMoves(state)).as(\"game %d ply %d\", game, plies).contains(move);\n                state = engine.apply(state, move, rng);\n                invariant.accept(state);\n                assertThat(++plies).as(\"game %d never ended\", game).isLessThan(MAX_PLIES);\n            }\n            assertThat(engine.legalMoves(state)).isEmpty();\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "package com.threeclassics.service;\n\nimport static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;\n\nimport com.threeclassics.core.Difficulty;\nimport com.threeclassics.core.GameMode;\nimport com.threeclassics.core.GameType;\nimport com.threeclassics.core.Side;\nimport java.util.UUID;\nimport org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;\n\nclass RematchPolicyTest {\n\n    private static NewGame request(GameType type, Side humanSide) {\n        return new NewGame(type, GameMode.VS_AI, Difficulty.MEDIUM, humanSide, UUID.randomUUID());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    void connectFourPlayAgainAlternatesTheStartingPlayer() {\n        assertThat(RematchPolicy.humanSide(request(GameType.CONNECT_FOUR, null), Side.P1)).isEqualTo(Side.P2);\n        assertThat(RematchPolicy.humanSide(request(GameType.CONNECT_FOUR, null), Side.P2)).isEqualTo(Side.P1);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    void anExplicitChoiceOverridesTheAlternation() {\n        assertThat(RematchPolicy.humanSide(request(GameType.CONNECT_FOUR, Side.P1), Side.P1)).isEqualTo(Side.P1);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    void otherGamesKeepTheHumansSide() {\n        assertThat(RematchPolicy.humanSide(request(GameType.CHECKERS, null), Side.P2)).isEqualTo(Side.P2);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    void aFreshGameDefaultsToTheHumanMovingFirst() {\n        NewGame fresh = new NewGame(GameType.CONNECT_FOUR, GameMode.VS_AI, Difficulty.EASY, null, null);\n        assertThat(RematchPolicy.humanSide(fresh, null)).isEqualTo(Side.P1);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    void localGamesAlwaysSeatPlayerOneFirst() {\n        NewGame local = new NewGame(GameType.CONNECT_FOUR, GameMode.LOCAL, Difficulty.EASY, Side.P2, null);\n        assertThat(RematchPolicy.humanSide(local, Side.P2)).isEqualTo(Side.P1);\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "package com.threeclassics.api;\n\nimport org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertyRegistry;\nimport org.springframework.test.context.DynamicPropertySource;\nimport org.testcontainers.DockerClientFactory;\nimport org.testcontainers.containers.PostgreSQLContainer;\n\n/**\n * Integration tests run against PostgreSQL: a Testcontainers instance when Docker is available,\n * or the database named by TEST_DATABASE_URL (plus TEST_DATABASE_USER/PASSWORD) when it is not.\n */\nabstract class DatabaseTest {\n\n    private static final String URL = System.getenv(\"TEST_DATABASE_URL\");\n    private static PostgreSQLContainer<?> container;\n\n    /** Used by {@code @EnabledIf} so the suite is skipped, not failed, without any database. */\n    static boolean databaseAvailable() {\n        return URL != null || DockerClientFactory.instance().isDockerAvailable();\n    }\n\n    @DynamicPropertySource\n    static void database(DynamicPropertyRegistry registry) {\n        if (URL != null) {\n            registry.add(\"spring.datasource.url\", () -> URL);\n            registry.add(\"spring.datasource.username\", () -> env(\"TEST_DATABASE_USER\", \"threeclassics\"));\n            registry.add(\"spring.datasource.password\", () -> env(\"TEST_DATABASE_PASSWORD\", \"threeclassics\"));\n            return;\n        }\n        synchronized (DatabaseTest.class) {\n            if (container == null) {\n                container = new PostgreSQLContainer<>(\"postgres:16-alpine\");\n                container.start();\n            }\n        }\n        registry.add(\"spring.datasource.url\", container::getJdbcUrl);\n        registry.add(\"spring.datasource.username\", container::getUsername);\n        registry.add(\"spring.datasource.password\", container::getPassword);\n    }\n\n    private static String env(String name, String fallback) {\n        String value = System.getenv(name);\n        return value == null ? fallback : value;\n    }\n}\n"
}

Paused keyframes still show a natural frame. */\n.scene:not([data-animate='true']) :global(*) {\n  animation-play-state: paused !important;\n}\n\n/* Behind a board the scene is a backdrop: desaturated, then darkened most behind the board. */\n.scene[data-scrim='true'] > .photo,\n.scene[data-scrim='true'] > svg,\n.scene[data-scrim='true'] > .canvas {\n  filter: saturate(0.55);\n}\n\n.scrim {\n  position: absolute;\n  inset: 0;\n  background: radial-gradient(\n    ellipse 65% 70% at var(--scrim-x, 50%) 55%,\n    var(--ui-scrim) 0%,\n    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-scrim) 70%, transparent) 60%,\n    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-scrim) 40%, transparent) 100%\n  );\n}\n"

'You win' : 'Computer wins';\n}\n"

  "content": "import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';\nimport type { HistoryEntry, Side } from '../../api/types';\nimport styles from './MoveList.module.css';\n\ninterface MoveListProps<M> {\n  history: HistoryEntry<M>[];\n  swatch: (side: Side) => ReactNode;\n}\n\nexport function MoveList<M>({ history, swatch }: MoveListProps<M>) {\n  const list = useRef<HTMLOListElement>(null);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const node = list.current;\n    if (node) node.scrollTop = node.scrollHeight;\n  }, [history.length]);\n\n  if (history.length === 0) {\n    return <p className={styles.empty}>No moves yet.</p>;\n  }\n  return (\n    <ol ref={list} className={styles.list}>\n      {history.map((entry) => (\n        <li key={entry.ply} className={styles.item}>\n          <span className={styles.ply}>{entry.ply + 1}</span>\n          <span className={styles.swatch}>{swatch(entry.side)}</span>\n          <span className={styles.notation}>{entry.notation}</span>\n        </li>\n      ))}\n    </ol>\n  );\n}\n"
}

  <p id={reasonId} className={styles.reason}>\n          {game.outcome?.reason}\n        </p>\n        <div className={styles.actions}>\n          <Button variant=\"primary\"   "content": "// Board geometry in SVG user units. Everything is drawn in this fixed coordinate system and the\n// SVG scales as a whole, so cells and discs can never change size.\nimport type { Side } from '../../api/types';\nimport type { ConnectFourState } from './types';\n\nexport const COLUMNS = 7;\nexport const ROWS = 6;\nexport const CELL = 100;\nexport const FRAME = 24;\n/** Strip above the frame where the preview disc hovers. */\nexport const PREVIEW = 96;\nexport const DISC_R = CELL * 0.4;\nexport const HOLE_R = CELL * 0.44;\n\nexport const VIEW_W = COLUMNS * CELL + 2 * FRAME;\nexport const VIEW_H = PREVIEW + ROWS * CELL + 2 * FRAME;\n\n/** Centre of a cell. Column 0 is on the left; row 0 is the bottom row. */\nexport function cellCenter(column: number, row: number): { x: number; y: number } {\n  return {\n    x: FRAME + column * CELL + CELL / 2,\n    y: PREVIEW + FRAME + (ROWS - 1 - row) * CELL + CELL / 2,\n  };\n}\n\nexport function columnX(column: number): number {\n  return FRAME + column * CELL + CELL / 2;\n}\n\nexport const PREVIEW_Y = PREVIEW / 2;\n\n/** Gravity feel: a longer fall takes a little longer. */\nexport function dropDuration(row: number): number {\n  return 260 + (ROWS - row) * 45;\n}\n\n/** What the board looks like right after a drop, drawn while the server confirms it. */\nexport function previewDrop(state: ConnectFourState, column: number, side: Side): ConnectFourState {\n  const columns = state.columns.map((discs, i) => (i === column ? [...discs, side] : discs));\n  return {\n    columns,\n    sideToMove: side === 'P1' ? 'P2' : 'P1',\n    winningLines: [],\n    lastDrop: { column, row: state.columns[column].length },\n  };\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { CELL, COLUMNS, ROWS, VIEW_H, VIEW_W, cellCenter, previewDrop } from './geometry';\nimport type { ConnectFourState } from './types';\n\ndescribe('Connect Four board mapping', () => {\n  it('puts column 0 on the left and row 0 at the bottom', () => {\n    const bottomLeft = cellCenter(0, 0);\n    const topRight = cellCenter(COLUMNS - 1, ROWS - 1);\n    expect(bottomLeft.x).toBeLessThan(topRight.x);\n    expect(bottomLeft.y).toBeGreaterThan(topRight.y);\n  });\n\n  it('spaces every cell exactly one cell apart inside the view box', () => {\n    for (let column = 0; column < COLUMNS; column++) {\n      for (let row = 0; row < ROWS; row++) {\n        const { x, y } = cellCenter(column, row);\n        expect(x - CELL / 2).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);\n        expect(x + CELL / 2).toBeLessThanOrEqual(VIEW_W);\n        expect(y + CELL / 2).toBeLessThanOrEqual(VIEW_H);\n        if (column > 0) expect(x - cellCenter(column - 1, row).x).toBe(CELL);\n        if (row > 0) expect(cellCenter(column, row - 1).y - y).toBe(CELL);\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('previews a drop at the lowest empty slot', () => {\n    const state: ConnectFourState = {\n      columns: [['P1', 'P2'], [], [], [], [], [], []],\n      sideToMove: 'P1',\n      winningLines: [],\n      lastDrop: null,\n    };\n    const next = previewDrop(state, 0, 'P1');\n    expect(next.columns[0]).toEqual(['P1', 'P2', 'P1']);\n    expect(next.lastDrop).toEqual({ column: 0, row: 2 });\n    expect(next.sideToMove).toBe('P2');\n    expect(state.columns[0]).toHaveLength(2);\n  });\n});\n"
}

{

humanSide?: 'P1' | 'P2' };\n  win: (page: Page) => Promise<void>;\n}\n\nexport const connectFour: GameFixture = {\n  name: 'Connect Four',\n  path: '/connect-four',\n  type: 'CONNECT_FOUR',\n  move: async (page) => {\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Column 4,/ }).click();\n  },\n  nearWin: {\n    state: {\n      columns: [['P1', 'P2'], ['P1', 'P2'], ['P1', 'P2'], [], [], [], []],\n      sideToMove: 'P1',\n      winningLines: [],\n      lastDrop: null,\n    },\n  },\n  win: async (page) => {\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^Column 4,/ }).click();\n  },\n};\n\nexport const GAMES: GameFixture[] = [connectFour];\n\nexport function moveItems(page: Page): Locator {\n  return page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Move list' }).getByRole('listitem');\n}\n\nexport async function waitForHumanTurn(page: Page) {\n  await expect(page.getByTestId('panel').getByText(/^(Your turn|.+ to move)$/)).toBeVisible();\n}\n\n/** Creates a game from a custom position (dev profile only) and makes the page resume it. */\nexport async function startFromPosition(page: Page, request: APIRequestContext, game: GameFixture) {\n  const response = await request.post('/api/dev/games', {\n    data: { game: { type: game.type, difficulty: 'EASY', humanSide: game.nearWin.humanSide }, state: game.nearWin.state },\n  });\n  expect(response.ok()).toBeTruthy();\n  const { game: view } = await response.json();\n  await page.goto('/');\n  await page.evaluate(([type, id]) => localStorage.setItem(`tc.game.${type}`, JSON.stringify(id)), [game.type, view.id]);\n  await page.goto(game.path);\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';\nimport { GAMES, waitForHumanTurn } from './games';\n\nconst VIEWPORTS = [\n  { width: 1280, height: 720 },\n  { width: 1440, height: 900 },\n  { width: 1920, height: 1080 },\n  { width: 390, height: 844 },\n];\n\ninterface Rect {\n  x: number;\n  y: number;\n  width: number;\n  height: number;\n}\n\nasync function cellRects(page: Page): Promise<Rect[]> {\n  return page.locator('[data-testid=\"board\"] [data-cell]').evaluateAll((cells) =>\n    cells.map((cell) => {\n      const r = cell.getBoundingClientRect();\n      return { x: r.x, y: r.y, width: r.width, height: r.height };\n    }),\n  );\n}\n\nfunction expectSameRects(a: Rect[], b: Rect[]) {\n  expect(a.length).toBe(b.length);\n  a.forEach((rect, i) => {\n    expect(Math.abs(rect.x - b[i].x)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.5);\n    expect(Math.abs(rect.y - b[i].y)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.5);\n    expect(Math.abs(rect.width - b[i].width)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.5);\n  });\n}\n\nfor (const game of GAMES) {\n  for (const viewport of VIEWPORTS) {\n    test(`${game.name} layout at ${viewport.width}×${viewport.height}`, async ({ page }) => {\n      await page.setViewportSize(viewport);\n      await page.goto(game.path);\n      await waitForHumanTurn(page);\n\n      // No scrollbars on the page itself.\n      const overflow = await page.evaluate(() => ({\n        x: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth,\n        y: document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight,\n      }));\n      expect(overflow.x).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0);\n      expect(overflow.y).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0);\n\n      // The board is fully visible and centred in its column.\n      const board = (await page.getByTestId('board').boundingBox())!;\n      const column = (await page.getByTestId('board-column').boundingBox())!;\n      expect(board.x).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);\n      expect(board.y).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);\n      expect(board.x + board.width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(viewport.width);\n      expect(board.y + board.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(viewport.height);\n      expect(Math.abs(board.x + board.width / 2 - (column.x + column.width / 2))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);\n      expect(Math.abs(board.y + board.height / 2 - (column.y + column.height / 2))).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);\n\n      // Every cell is the same size.\n      const cells = await cellRects(page);\n      expect(cells.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n      for (const cell of cells) {\n        expect(Math.abs(cell.width - cells[0].width)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.5);\n        expect(Math.abs(cell.height - cells[0].height)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(0.5);\n      }\n\n      // Nothing sits on top of the board: sample a grid of points and hit-test them.\n      const covered = await page.evaluate((b) => {\n        const host = document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"board\"]')!;\n        const misses: string[] = [];\n        for (const fx of [0.1, 0.5, 0.9]) {\n          for (const fy of [0.1, 0.5, 0.9]) {\n            const hit = document.elementFromPoint(b.x + b.width * fx, b.y + b.height * fy);\n            if (!hit || !host.contains(hit)) misses.push(`${fx},${fy}: ${hit?.tagName}.${hit?.className}`);\n          }\n        }\n        return misses;\n      }, board);\n      expect(covered).toEqual([]);\n\n      // Cells don't move or resize when a move is played and the computer replies.\n      await game.move(page);\n      expectSameRects(await cellRects(page), cells);\n      await waitForHumanTurn(page);\n      expectSameRects(await cellRects(page), cells);\n      const after = (await page.getByTestId('board').boundingBox())!;\n      expect(after).toEqual(board);\n    });\n  }\n}\n"
}

Bash Log Connect Four decisions and commit Milestone 2
cd /c/Users/ustec/Downloads/Chess_Project && cat >> docs/DECISIONS.md <<'EOF'
- **The client previews only what it was offered.** When the human picks a move, the board draws it
  at once (a dropped disc, a slid checker) so input never waits on the network or the AI. The server
  still validates it, and the board snaps to the server's state from the response.
- **Shared game shell.** Top bar, centred board column, side panel, rules drawer, confirm dialogs and the
  result modal are one component (`GameShell`) plus one hook (`useGameSession`). Each game supplies its
  board, side names, swatches and rules. Connect Four set the pattern; the others reuse it unchanged.

## Connect Four

- **AI levels follow the solved game.** With perfect play the first player wins by opening in the
  centre, so Hard always opens there. Medium opens in one of the three middle columns and then picks
  at random among moves within a few points of its best, so games vary. Easy plays randomly but takes
  a win or blocks one about half the time each.
- **Hard's search** is negamax with alpha-beta on a bitboard, a transposition table, centre-first move
  ordering and iterative deepening against an 85% slice of the one-second budget. An explicit
  "win now, else block a single threat" check runs first, which is exactly what the tests demand.
- **Discs fall behind the frame.** The SVG draws hole backs, then discs, then the frame with round
  holes cut out, so a falling disc is only visible through the holes, like the real thing.
- **Colour plus shape.** Gold discs carry a centre dot, so the two sides differ by more than colour.
  The turn marker in the panel is a bar as well as a highlight.
EOF

mapping, Playwright e2e and layout tests, and reviewed screenshots.

  "content": "package com.threeclassics.checkers;\n\nimport com.threeclassics.core.Side;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/** Builds checkers positions from algebraic squares as Dark sees the board (a1 bottom-left). */\nfinal class Position {\n\n    private final char[] board = new char[64];\n\n    private Position() {\n        Arrays.fill(board, CheckersState.EMPTY);\n    }\n\n    static Position empty() {\n        return new Position();\n    }\n\n    Position put(char piece, String... squares) {\n        for (String square : squares) {\n            board[sq(square)] = piece;\n        }\n        return this;\n    }\n\n    CheckersState toMove(Side side) {\n        return toMove(side, 0);\n    }\n\n    CheckersState toMove(Side side, int quietPlies) {\n        return new CheckersState(new String(board), side, quietPlies, null, null);\n    }\n\n    static int sq(String square) {\n        int column = square.charAt(0) - 'a';\n        int row = 8 - (square.charAt(1) - '0');\n        if ((row + column) % 2 == 0) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(square + \" is a light square\");\n        }\n        return row * 8 + column;\n    }\n\n    static CheckersMove move(String... squares) {\n        return new CheckersMove(Arrays.stream(squares).map(Position::sq).toList(), List.of());\n    }\n\n    static CheckersMove jump(List<String> path, List<String> captures) {\n        return new CheckersMove(path.stream().map(Position::sq).toList(), captures.stream().map(Position::sq).toList());\n    }\n}\n"
}

Hard takes it.\n        CheckersState state = Position.empty().put('d', \"c5\", \"a1\").put('l', \"d6\", \"h8\").toMove(Side.P2);\n        CheckersMove chosen = ai.chooseMove(state, Difficulty.HARD, new Random(1), Duration.ofSeconds(1));\n        assertThat(chosen).isEqualTo(jump(List.of(\"d6\", \"b4\"), List.of(\"c5\")));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    void hardAvoidsHangingAPiece() {\n        // Dark's c3 man can step into d4, where e5 would capture it, or to b4, which is safe.\n        CheckersState state = Position.empty().put('d', \"c3\", \"a1\").put('l', \"e5\", \"h8\").toMove(Side.P1);\n        CheckersMove chosen = ai.chooseMove(state, Difficulty.HARD, new Random(1), Duration.ofSeconds(1));\n        assertThat(chosen).isNotEqualTo(move(\"c3\", \"d4\"));\n    }\n\n    private void assertAnswersInTime(CheckersState state) {\n        long start = System.nanoTime();\n        CheckersMove chosen = ai.chooseMove(state, Difficulty.HARD, new Random(5), Duration.ofSeconds(1));\n        long elapsedMs = (System.nanoTime() - start) / 1_000_000;\n        assertThat(elapsedMs).isLessThan(2000);\n        assertThat(engine.legalMoves(state)).contains(chosen);\n    }\n}\n"

The player builds one click by click; these helpers decide which next step\n// is allowed by checking that the steps so far are a prefix of at least one legal sequence.\n\nexport type Equals<T> = (a: T, b: T) => boolean;\n\nconst same: Equals<unknown> = (a, b) => a === b;\n\nfunction startsWith<T>(sequence: T[], prefix: T[], equals: Equals<T>): boolean {\n  if (prefix.length > sequence.length) return false;\n  return prefix.every((step, i) => equals(step, sequence[i]));\n}\n\n/** Sequences that begin with the given steps. */\nexport function matching<T>(sequences: T[][], prefix: T[], equals: Equals<T> = same): T[][] {\n  return sequences.filter((sequence) => startsWith(sequence, prefix, equals));\n}\n\n/** Every distinct step that can follow the prefix. */\nexport function nextSteps<T>(sequences: T[][], prefix: T[], equals: Equals<T> = same): T[] {\n  const steps: T[] = [];\n  for (const sequence of matching(sequences, prefix, equals)) {\n    if (sequence.length <= prefix.length) continue;\n    const step = sequence[prefix.length];\n    if (!steps.some((existing) => equals(existing, step))) steps.push(step);\n  }\n  return steps;\n}\n\n/** The index of the sequence that the prefix completes exactly, or -1. */\nexport function completedBy<T>(sequences: T[][], prefix: T[], equals: Equals<T> = same): number {\n  return sequences.findIndex((sequence) => sequence.length === prefix.length && startsWith(sequence, prefix, equals));\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\nimport { completedBy, matching, nextSteps } from './prefix';\n\ndescribe('legal-prefix matcher', () => {\n  // Two checkers moves from square 42: a simple step, and a double jump through 28.\n  const paths = [\n    [42, 33],\n    [42, 28, 14],\n    [46, 37],\n  ];\n\n  it('offers the first step of every sequence when nothing is chosen', () => {\n    expect(nextSteps(paths, [])).toEqual([42, 46]);\n  });\n\n  it('offers only steps that continue a legal prefix', () => {\n    expect(nextSteps(paths, [42])).toEqual([33, 28]);\n    expect(nextSteps(paths, [42, 28])).toEqual([14]);\n    expect(nextSteps(paths, [46])).toEqual([37]);\n  });\n\n  it('offers nothing after an illegal step', () => {\n    expect(nextSteps(paths, [42, 35])).toEqual([]);\n    expect(matching(paths, [42, 35])).toEqual([]);\n  });\n\n  it('recognises a completed sequence but not a partial one', () => {\n    expect(completedBy(paths, [42, 28])).toBe(-1);\n    expect(completedBy(paths, [42, 28, 14])).toBe(1);\n    expect(completedBy(paths, [42, 33])).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it('deduplicates steps shared by several sequences', () => {\n    const turns = [\n      [{ from: 24, to: 18 }, { from: 18, to: 13 }],\n      [{ from: 24, to: 18 }, { from: 13, to: 8 }],\n      [{ from: 13, to: 8 }, { from: 24, to: 18 }],\n    ];\n    const equals = (a: { from: number; to: number }, b: { from: number; to: number }) => a.from === b.from && a.to === b.to;\n    expect(nextSteps(turns, [], equals)).toEqual([\n      { from: 24, to: 18 },\n      { from: 13, to: 8 },\n    ]);\n    expect(nextSteps(turns, [{ from: 24, to: 18 }], equals)).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(completedBy(turns, [{ from: 13, to: 8 }, { from: 24, to: 18 }], equals)).toBe(2);\n  });\n});\n"
}

  "content": "import type { Side } from '../../api/types';\nimport type { CheckersMove, CheckersState, Piece } from './types';\n\nexport const SIZE = 8;\nexport const CELL = 100;\nexport const FRAME = 20;\nexport const VIEW = SIZE * CELL + 2 * FRAME;\nexport const PIECE_R = CELL * 0.38;\nexport const HOP_MS = 300;\n\n/** Playable squares have row + column odd, so a1 (bottom-left for Dark) is playable. */\nexport function isPlayable(square: number): boolean {\n  return (Math.floor(square / SIZE) + (square % SIZE)) % 2 === 1;\n}\n\n/**\n * Screen position (top-left of the cell) of a board square. The board is drawn from the human's\n * side: when they play Light it is turned 180°, so their pieces are always at the bottom.\n */\nexport function squareOrigin(square: number, flipped: boolean): { x: number; y: number } {\n  const row = Math.floor(square / SIZE);\n  const column = square % SIZE;\n  const screenRow = flipped ? SIZE - 1 - row : row;\n  const screenColumn = flipped ? SIZE - 1 - column : column;\n  return { x: FRAME + screenColumn * CELL, y: FRAME + screenRow * CELL };\n}\n\nexport function squareCenter(square: number, flipped: boolean): { x: number; y: number } {\n  const { x, y } = squareOrigin(square, flipped);\n  return { x: x + CELL / 2, y: y + CELL / 2 };\n}\n\n/** The square shown at a screen row and column. */\nexport function squareAt(screenRow: number, screenColumn: number, flipped: boolean): number {\n  const row = flipped ? SIZE - 1 - screenRow : screenRow;\n  const column = flipped ? SIZE - 1 - screenColumn : screenColumn;\n  return row * SIZE + column;\n}\n\n/** Algebraic name as Dark sees the board, matching the server's notation (a1 bottom-left). */\nexport function squareName(square: number): string {\n  return `${String.fromCharCode(97 + (square % SIZE))}${SIZE - Math.floor(square / SIZE)}`;\n}\n\nexport function owner(piece: string): Side | null {\n  if (piece === 'd' || piece === 'D') return 'P1';\n  if (piece === 'l' || piece === 'L') return 'P2';\n  return null;\n}\n\nexport function isKing(piece: string): boolean {\n  return piece === 'D' || piece === 'L';\n}\n\nexport function describePiece(piece: string): string {\n  if (piece === '.') return 'empty';\n  return `${owner(piece) === 'P1' ? 'dark' : 'light'} ${isKing(piece) ? 'king' : 'man'}`;\n}\n\n/** The board right after a move, drawn while the server confirms it. */\nexport function previewMove(state: CheckersState, move: CheckersMove): CheckersState {\n  const board = state.board.split('');\n  let piece = board[move.path[0]] as Piece;\n  board[move.path[0]] = '.';\n  for (const captured of move.captures) board[captured] = '.';\n  const to = move.path[move.path.length - 1];\n  const crowningRow = owner(piece) === 'P1' ? 0 : SIZE - 1;\n  if (!isKing(piece) && Math.floor(to / SIZE) === crowningRow) piece = piece.toUpperCase() as Piece;\n  board[to] = piece;\n  return { ...state, board: board.join(''), sideToMove: state.sideToMove === 'P1' ? 'P2' : 'P1', lastMove: move };\n}\n"
}

square < SIZE * SIZE; square++) {\n        const { x, y } = squareOrigin(square, flipped);\n        expect(squareAt((y - FRAME) / CELL, (x - FRAME) / CELL, flipped)).toBe(square);\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  it('names squares like the server does', () => {\n    expect(squareName(sq('c3'))).toBe('c3');\n    expect(squareName(sq('h8'))).toBe('h8');\n  });\n\n  it('previews a capture that crowns', () => {\n    const board = '.'.repeat(64).split('');\n    board[sq('d6')] = 'd';\n    board[sq('e7')] = 'l';\n    const state: CheckersState = { board: board.join(''), sideToMove: 'P1', quietPlies: 0, positions: [], lastMove: null };\n    const next = previewMove(state, { path: [sq('d6'), sq('f8')], captures: [sq('e7')] });\n    expect(next.board[sq('f8')]).toBe('D');\n    expect(next.board[sq('e7')]).toBe('.');\n    expect(next.board[sq('d6')]).toBe('.');\n    expect(next.sideToMove).toBe('P2');\n  });\n});\n"

range[0]);\n  const layers = LAYERS.map((layer) => ({\n    layer,\n    flakes: Array.from({ length: Math.round(total * layer.share) }, (): Flake => ({\n      x: Math.random() * width,\n      y: Math.random() * height,\n      r: rand(layer.size),\n      speed: rand(layer.speed),\n      sway: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.8,\n      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,\n    })),\n  }));\n\n  return {\n    update(dt, now) {\n      const wind = 14 * Math.sin(now / 9000) + 8 * Math.sin(now / 23000 + 1);\n      for (const { layer, flakes } of layers) {\n        for (const f of flakes) {\n          f.y += f.speed * dt;\n          f.x += (wind * layer.wind + Math.sin(now / 1000 * f.sway + f.phase) * 10) * dt;\n          if (f.y > height + 6) {\n            f.y = -6;\n            f.x = Math.random() * width;\n          }\n          if (f.x > width + 6) f.x = -6;\n          else if (f.x < -6) f.x = width + 6;\n        }\n      }\n    },\n    draw(ctx) {\n      for (const { layer, flakes } of layers) {\n        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(251, 253, 255, ${layer.alpha})`;\n        for (const f of flakes) {\n          ctx.beginPath();\n          ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n          ctx.fill();\n        }\n        if (layer.soft) {\n          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(251, 253, 255, ${layer.alpha * 0.18})`;\n          for (const f of flakes) {\n            ctx.beginPath();\n            ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n            ctx.fill();\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    },\n  };\n};\n\n/** A row of snow-laden pines along a baseline. */\nfunction pines(baseline: number, count: number, height: number, seed: number) {\n  const trees: string[] = [];\n  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n    const jitter = Math.sin(seed + i * 12.9898) * 0.5 + 0.5;\n    const x = (i + 0.2 + jitter * 0.6) * (1600 / count);\n    const h = height * (0.7 + jitter * 0.5);\n    const w = h * 0.36;\n    const y = baseline + jitter * 10;\n    trees.push(\n      `M${x} ${y - h} L${x + w * 0.35} ${y - h * 0.62} L${x + w * 0.2} ${y - h * 0.62} L${x + w * 0.55} ${y - h * 0.3} L${x + w * 0.3} ${y - h * 0.3} L${x + w * 0.5} ${y} L${x - w * 0.5} ${y} L${x - w * 0.3} ${y - h * 0.3} L${x - w * 0.55} ${y - h * 0.3} L${x - w * 0.2} ${y - h * 0.62} L${x - w * 0.35} ${y - h * 0.62} Z`,\n    );\n  }\n  return trees.join(' ');\n}\n\nconst FAR_PINES = pines(745, 26, 70, 3);\nconst NEAR_PINES = pines(905, 14, 190, 7);\n\nexport function WinterScene(props: SceneProps) {\n  return (\n    <SceneFrame name=\"winter\" particles={snow} {...props}>\n      <div className={styles.sky} />\n      <div className={styles.aurora} />\n      <svg className={styles.land} viewBox=\"0 0 1600 1000\" preserveAspectRatio=\"xMidYMax slice\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n        <path\n          className={styles.ridgeFar}\n          d=\"M0 640 L120 560 L210 600 L330 480 L4

Dark moves first.</li>\n        <li>A man steps one square diagonally forward onto an empty square.</li>\n        <li>A king steps one square diagonally in any direction. Kings don't fly across the board.</li>\n      </ul>\n\n      <h3>Capturing</h3>\n      <ul>\n        <li>Jump diagonally over an enemy piece next to you into the empty square behind it. The jumped piece is removed.</li>\n        <li>Capturing is required: if any capture is available, you must take one.</li>\n        <li>When there's a choice of captures, you may pick any of them, even a shorter one.</li>\n        <li>After a jump, keep jumping with the same piece while you can. You can't jump the same piece twice.</li>\n        <li>Men capture forward only; kings capture in both directions.</li>\n      </ul>\n\n      <h3>Crowning</h3>\n      <ul>\n        <li>A man that reaches the far row becomes a king, shown as a double piece with a crown.</li>\n        <li>If that happens during a jump, the move ends there.</li>\n      </ul>\n\n      <h3>Draws</h3>\n      <ul>\n        <li>40 moves each with no capture and no man moved.</li>\n        <li>The same position, with the same player to move, appearing three times.</li>\n      </ul>\n\n      <h3>Controls</h3>\n      <ul>\n        <li>Click a piece to see where it can go, then click a highlighted square. For a multi-jump, click each landing square in turn.</li>\n        <li>Click the piece again or press Esc to change your mind before the move is complete.</li>\n        <li>With the keyboard, use the arrow keys to move between squares and Enter to select.</li>\n      </ul>\n    </>\n  );\n}\n"
}
